# setbaud

Causes Tera Term to change speed of serial port. *(version 4.58 or later)*

```ttl
setbaud <value>
```

## Parameters

**integer &lt;value&gt; (less than version 4.66)**

The corresponding ID of speed. value speed (bps) 1 110 2 300 3 600 4 1200 5 2400 6 4800 7 9600 8 14400 9 19200 10 38400 11 57600 12 115200 13 230400 14 460800 15 921600

**integer &lt;value&gt; (version 4.66 or later)**

The immediate speed.

## Example

```ttl
; change speed to 115200 bps

; less than version 4.66
setbaud 12

; version 4.66 or later
setbaud 115200
```
